articles.title: Man Utd Managerial Costs Near £100m
articles.summary: Manchester United borrowed funds shortly after confirming Mauricio Pochettino as their new head coach, incurring significant compensation costs owed to US Soccer for his appointment.

articles.title: NFL Legend Tom Brady Eyes Chelsea Investment
articles.summary: American football icon Tom Brady is reportedly exploring a potential financial investment in Premier League club Chelsea through their ownership group, Clearlake Capital.

articles.title: Mudryk Accuses Shevchenko of Lying Over Drugs Test
articles.summary: Mykhailo Mudryk has publicly accused Ukraine legend Andriy Shevchenko of lying about the circumstances surrounding the winger's controversial positive drugs test amid an ongoing dispute with the national football federation.

articles.title: Transfer Gossip: Osimhen and Diallo Linked
articles.summary: Victor Osimhen is reportedly keen on securing a move to Manchester United, while Aston Villa monitor Amad Diallo and Crystal Palace target Ivan Toney in the latest football transfer gossip roundup.

articles.title: Chelsea Loanee Kavuma-McQueen Impressing at Portsmouth
articles.summary: Seventeen-year-old Chelsea loanee Ryan Kavuma-McQueen has been turning heads and dominating Championship defenders during his impressive stint with Portsmouth, earning high praise from manager John Mousinho.

articles.title: Man Utd CEO Berrada Defends Club Hierarchy
articles.summary: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada has spoken out regarding fan backlash, stating that some of the recent criticism directed at the club's hierarchy has crossed a line.

articles.title: Arteta Warns Arsenal Over FPL Leaks
articles.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has issued a warning to his players regarding the inadvertent leaking of confidential team news through Fantasy Premier League applications.

articles.title: Lampard Demands Fairness After Penalty Controversy
articles.summary: Coventry City manager Frank Lampard has called on match officials to ensure greater accuracy following an incident where his side was denied a crucial penalty against Everton.

articles.title: Iraola Calls for Drone Filming Ban
articles.summary: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has voiced concerns over privacy and spying in football, suggesting that the practice of filming training sessions with drones should be made illegal.

articles.title: Harry Kane Ruled Out for Months With Ankle Injury
articles.summary: Bayern Munich have confirmed that England forward Harry Kane will be sidelined for the next few months after suffering a severe ankle ligament tear during a Bundesliga match against Cologne.

articles.title: Tom Brady in Talks to Buy Chelsea Stake
articles.summary: NFL legend Tom Brady is reportedly in discussions to acquire a minority stake in Chelsea, having recently sold his share in Birmingham City to facilitate potential investment at Stamford Bridge.

articles.title: George Russell Slams Max Verstappen After Las Vegas Clash
articles.summary: George Russell launched a scathing criticism of Max Verstappen following a collision between the pair during final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, ahead of a race where they start on the front row.

articles.title: Toto Wolff Defends Mercedes Qualifying Strategy
articles.summary: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff dismissed suggestions that the team failed to support George Russell in qualifying, insisting the British driver had the perfect track position during his final run in Las Vegas.

articles.title: Verstappen on Pole After Dramatic Las Vegas Qualifying
articles.summary: Kimi Antonelli set the pace in Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying, but a grid penalty hands Max Verstappen pole position ahead of Mercedes driver George Russell.

articles.title: Pat Cummins Retains Australia Captaincy
articles.summary: Pat Cummins has received unanimous backing from Cricket Australia to remain as the Test and ODI captain, confirming his participation in an upcoming independent forum.

articles.title: Russell and Verstappen Crash in Las Vegas Practice
articles.summary: Tempers flared at the Las Vegas Grand Prix as George Russell and Max Verstappen collided with one another during a dramatic final practice session.

articles.title: Ferrari Drivers Shocked After Early Vegas Exit
articles.summary: Charles Leclerc expressed anger while Lewis Hamilton admitted to feeling devastated after both Ferrari drivers suffered shock eliminations during the early stages of Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying.
